hypotheses.claim: Exact external attestation-document digest binding in EntityOSBuildReceipt/v1 strengthens durable provenance replay without creating a second runtime path.

The current external attestation may intentionally be the authority, so absence of its digest is not by itself an exploit; the narrower defect is inability to identify the exact authority document from the build receipt alone.

required_hardening: Extend SourceProvenance with source_attestation_sha256 nullable for Git-clean mode.
Hash the exact external attestation bytes after successful validation in ATTESTED_SNAPSHOT_V2 mode.
Make the build-internal Vercel lane compare receipt source_attestation_sha256 with the independently staged manifest-bound attestation digest.
Add deterministic ordinary regressions for exact digest binding and substituted-authority mismatch; these are not a second unusual experiment.
